text:
sam (eng-runtime): quick heads-up: vuln sweep found fixes we should pull into a hardened base image. artifacts built but unsigned. want to coordinate signing + RBAC + audit retention before rollout.

leah (eng-security): thanks. immediate asks: SBOM + predicate in attestations, KMS-backed signing (avoid keyless), RBAC so only infra-builds SA + 2 approvers can promote, and audit logs preserved for 13 months.

sam (eng-runtime): agreed. CI emits SBOM already; will add git SHA + changelog URL to the predicate. plan: canary 5% -> 25% -> full (24h) if gates pass. rollback = route back & revoke tag.

rahul (eng-infra): i can provision an AWS CMK under alias/rebuild-3969-temp (HSM-backed if requested). will attach kms:Sign + kms:GetPublicKey to infra-builds role. ETA ~30m. will also enable CloudTrail data events for ecr and s3 so attestations are recorded.

maya (oncall): rollout windows? i can cover canary monitoring. thresholds: crashloop >0.5% for 5m or image-pull errors spike -> pause and rollback. who triggers rollback?

sam (eng-runtime): i'll trigger rollback and post runbook link. maya you'll escalate to SRE/sr oncall if noisy.

leah (eng-security): enforcement: require CI approval gate (two approvers) before cosign runs. also need attestations to include KMS key ARN and signing principal for forensics. SIEM retention must be bumped to 13 months for this event.

rahul (eng-infra): IAM snippet i'll apply to infra-builds role:

```
aws iam put-role-policy --role-name infra-builds --policy-name RebuildCosignPolicy --policy-document '{\n  "Version":"2012-10-17",\n  "Statement":[{\n    "Effect":"Allow",\n    "Action":["kms:Sign","kms:GetPublicKey","kms:DescribeKey"],\n    "Resource":"arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/REBUILD_3969"\n  }]\n}'
```

rahul (eng-infra): and kubectl rolebinding so the build controller can read attestation objects in `attest` ns:

```
kubectl create rolebinding build-controller-attest-reader -n attest --role=attest-reader --serviceaccount=infra:build-controller
```

leah (eng-security): add a condition to the IAM policy limiting Sign to our CI IPs and the EKS OIDC role. also require CloudTrail logValidation on the S3 bucket storing attestations. open ticket to extend SIEM retention.

ci-bot: artifact available: https://artifacts.internal.redwood/base-hardened/3969999999 — unsigned

signing-bot: signing queue awaiting approvals; cosign step not run until CI gate passes.

sam (eng-runtime): CI snippet to add (high level):

```
- run: cosign sign --key ksm://alias/rebuild-3969-temp registry.redwood/base-hardened:sha
- run: cosign attest --predicate sbom.json --key ksm://alias/rebuild-3969-temp registry.redwood/base-hardened:sha
- run: aws s3 cp sbom.json s3://redwood-attestations/base-hardened/3969999999/sbom.json
```

leah (eng-security): ensure sbom.json contains SPDX ids and package hashes. predicate should include git_sha, changelog_url, and ksm_key_arn. we will also capture cloudtrail events for kms:Sign calls.

maya (oncall): starting provisional canary window at 11:30 PT. will watch p95/p99, crashloops, image-pull errors. if thresholds hit, i'll pause and call rollback.

rahul (eng-infra): key created: arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/REBUILD_3969. applied IAM policy and rolebinding. opened INFRA ticket #INFRA-4680 to extend CloudTrail/S3 retention and enable validation.

leah (eng-security): approving CI gate now (approver note). once signed, i'll verify attestations and SBOM hashes before promotion. add an audit note in the ticket with diff and test evidence.

sam (eng-runtime): starting 5% canary now. will post metrics in ~10m. keeping all updates in this thread.

maya (oncall): standing by — will escalate if crashloops > 0.5% sustained for 5m.
